verdict.rationale: EmailOctopus has its own automation feature: the v2 API can start an automation for a specific contact, and the marketing site mentions timed sending. However, the evidence never describes how automations are built or triggered, or confirms they run unattended in the background. missing for 10: documentation of automation setup (triggers, workflow steps, delays), evidence of recurring or event-driven background execution, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
